name: game-graph-fit-alignment
goal: Fit View leaves every checkpoint fully visible on every platform's canvas size

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Hosted CI 39739619744 job 119693909782 at b62d622: native 2d/3d desktop authoring fails after Fit View; Collect the key viewport ratio 0.9999998807907104, expected 1. Linux only; macOS passes. Diagnosis: Fit View lands on full-precision sub-pixel pan/zoom, so Chromium's IntersectionObserver loses one float32 ulp on visible nodes. Local macOS sweep reproduces it at 11/16 tablet and 10/16 mobile widths.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: packages/desktop/tests/e2e/game-native.spec.ts (game-authoring scenario) asserts only the key node at one canvas size per declared viewport. That size is platform-specific (fonts, classic 15px scrollbars), so macOS never sampled a non-exact fit. Strengthen author(): after the unchanged key assertion, Fit View across a 0-15px gutter band of each viewport must keep all five checkpoints fully in view.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red 2e362fa record 19ef7f3570be: unchanged native matrix fails 2d/3d tablet and mobile, 'Fit View must show every checkpoint 1 px narrower', ratios 0.99999928/0.99999857; desktop passes on macOS. 432 measurements, 178 capture bindings retained. Hosted Linux b62 failure is the desktop instance.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus 5.5 added GameGraphFit (desktop.component.game-authoring-game-graph-fit): after xyflow fitView it sets a whole-pixel pan and floor-1/64 zoom around the same centre, on open too. GameGraph hides the library fit button. Test unchanged. Fix 171fedb.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same-process paired proof 2e362fa record 19ef7f3570be (4 fail, 2 pass) to 171fedb record c002252fdc89 (6 pass, 26.7s), identical 1367 frozen inputs and profile f480bbf5. Green keeps 54 screenshots, 342 bindings, 816 measurements; fit-graph desktop/tablet/mobile inspected.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
